name: Grid
source: A frame gallery for design docs.
fit: A dense gallery of screen tiles.
layout: Cases are tiles in a responsive grid, denser than the card index. The label sits on the tile.
typography: One display title for the page. Small labels on the tiles. The gallery itself has no long prose.
fonts: Space Grotesk for the display title. DM Sans for tile labels. Space Mono for code, token names, and file paths.
icons: Lucide. layout-grid marks the gallery, image a screen tile, file-text the brief, palette the design system.
nav: Open a tile for that screen. The brief and the design system are tiles on the index too.
frames: The tile is the frame. Light and dark are shown on the tile.
chrome: Neutral light and dark for the docs chrome, separate from the product themes inside the frames.
adapt: Keep the dense tile grid and the display title. Keep the chrome neutral so it does not compete with the product.
